notes.note: Reviewed the listing and alias-eviction delta against the cited session, authority, dispatch and walkthrough claims. Both listings reuse the inventory only when eviction did not change it. Actual deletion still invalidates the owner cache and forces a fresh inventory read, with deletion errors propagated. The existing API, request and historical capture claims remain accurate. The SQLite-backed caller fixture observes one read per listing on the no-eviction path and a fresh read after eviction. This does not measure Nightly CPU or ADEMark.
